dimensions.assessment: Directs federal agencies to investigate and report on an issue affecting minors, social media platforms, and law enforcement.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the relevant congressional committees... a report on the ability of minors to access fentanyl

dimensions.assessment: Mandates an information-gathering study and public report rather than imposing direct operational or behavioral restrictions on platforms.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the relevant congressional committees and make publicly available on the website of the Commission a report

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations or direct federal spending amounts are specified in the source text for compiling the report.
Imposes a one-time reporting and consultation requirement on the FTC and partner agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Commission... shall submit to the relevant congressional committees... a report

dimensions.assessment: Involves a single, time-limited report due within one year of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Any authorized funding level or estimated cost for preparing the FTC report.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Federal Trade Commission, in coordination with other agencies, to conduct a study and submit a report to Congress on minors' ability to access fentanyl through social media platforms.
